### Salmon River Coloring Book

This work was put together by technician Taryn Elliott and me. It showcases the algal succession pattern we observed on the Salmon River in northern California (*a tributary to the Klamath River!*). We drew the line art with digital software and a tablet and I came up with the rhyming text one day when I was feeling poetic.

It is publicly hosted on the [Open Educational Resources Commons](https://oercommons.org/courseware/lesson/141536). Please feel free to use it!
